A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bandwidth of an optical transmission system is limited by the source linewidth, and not by dispersion.
the broadening of the pulse due to the source linewidth can be neglected in comparison to the broadening due to the pulse bandwidth.
the bandwidth of a monomode fiber system is not limited by the bandwidth of the source but by the bandwidth of a received pulse.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the source linewidth must be taken into consideration for accurate pulse broadening calculations.
the pulse broadening is a function of the linewidth of the laser, the pulse duration of the laser, and the dispersion of the fiber.
